verdict.rationale: GitHub's own marketing documents project-planning tools: you can create issues and manage projects (github-docs-12), organize work from roadmaps to everyday tasks (github-docs-8), and manage projects from mobile (github-docs-4). However, nothing in the pack mentions a kanban/board view or columns, so only the general planning-and-tracking core is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of kanban board views, configurable columns/status fields, moving cards between columns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
